purpose: compute the Berline-Vergne weight of every isometry class of the rank-five codimension-five edge atlas and decide the signs
command: python3 run.py (resumable: it appends to atlas.jsonl and restarts where it stopped)
inputs: ../symbolic-computation-run-1/classes.json, the 3,406 isometry classes of the edge types of 2,000 full-dimensional five-part hive polytopes
method: transverse.py converts a normal set to the polar cone in the projected lattice; bvweight.py evaluates the Berline-Vergne recursion; non-simplicial cones are triangulated and summed by the valuation property
